classification_rules.publication_only: The currently served page and its reported date were inspected, but the exact text at a historical cutoff was not established. A repository link without an inspected immutable revision remains in this class.
classification_rules.version_verifiable: An accession-specific archived filing or exhibit was inspected and its filing/acceptance metadata was inspected. This is an archival anchor, not a claim that local bytes were downloaded or checksummed.
classification_rules.source_prefix_policy: SEC acceptance is an archival event, not proof of exact public availability or unchanged historical bytes. Development replay uses next-day operational cutoffs only. Strict benchmark admission requires historical availability evidence.
